 By Stephen Whiteside Market Overview Published 10/20/2026, 08:57 AM VIX, Bonds and Crude Oil: Tuesday’s Critical Market Signals View all comments (0) 0 VIX, Bonds and Crude Oil: Tuesday’s Critical Market Signals View all comments (0) 0 Stephen Whiteside Articles ( 149 ) | My Homepage Follow In this article: CL + 0.32% USO -0.12% Crude oil is the central focus of Tuesday’s market outlook, rising sharply in pre-market trading and breaking above the $162.50 level on the USO ETF . With stock index futures slightly lower and gold moving down, energy prices could determine the direction of Canadian stocks. Toronto energy shares advanced, while most other TSX sectors declined on Monday. Gasoline remains elevated, and ongoing geopolitical conflicts could limit the potential for a meaningful pullback in energy prices.
 Beyond energy, major North American stock indices recorded inside days, signaling a pause rather than a confirmed change in trend. Bond weakness, rising yields, and continued selling pressure in junk bonds point to a cautious investment environment. Natural gas has entered a second day on a sell signal, copper remains under pressure, and silver miners continue to show weakness. Traders should watch crude oil, Friday’s trading ranges, and established technical support levels for clues about the market’s next move.
